charts.title: TIC 139270665 b: orbits around TIC 139270665
charts.description: The orbits of TIC 139270665's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TIC 139270665 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Peluso et al. 2024 (2024AJ....167..170P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PELUSO_ET_AL__2024): P 23.624 d

charts.title: TIC 139270665 b: its transit
charts.description: TIC 139270665 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (47) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 139270665, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 24-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 24-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
